en-US.name: Hearth Universal
en-US.summary: Open-source glass-box personal operating system on Alexa+ MCP.
en-US.description: Hearth Universal connects Alexa+ to local home automation, subscription hygiene, and multi-resident arbitration under the Propose-Never-Execute contract. Multi-modal: voice + Fire TV D-pad/keyboard + APL visual cards in a single turn, with TTS queue, Echo chime, light-wave hooks, and a ReAct visualizer trace.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Hearth to run a subscription audit
Alexa, ask Hearth to solve the thermostat dispute
Alexa, show me the pending approval tray
Alexa, turn on the living room lights
Alexa, set the thermostat to 21 degrees
Alexa, show me the thermostat card
